en.description:
Important Note: This app can only be downloaded from the App Store on Apple Watch. Here's how:
1. Press the Digital Crown on your watch to open the app list
2. Find and open the App Store
3. Scroll to the bottom and tap [Account]
4. Find [Purchased] to download the app


Color Block for Watch
Rediscover the classic falling block puzzle game, now beautifully reimagined for your Apple Watch! Color Block for Watch brings you a fun and addictive block-stacking experience with vibrant visuals and smooth controls.
KEY FEATURES:
Classic block puzzle gameplay, easy to learn and hard to master
Beautiful starry backgrounds and dynamic animations
Intuitive touch controls: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down to drop
Ghost piece preview to help you plan your moves
Exciting particle effects when you clear lines
Score tracking and high score system
Optimized for Apple Watch display
Satisfying sound effects and smooth performance
HOW TO PLAY:
Tap to rotate blocks
Swipe left or right to move blocks
Swipe down for a quick drop
Clear lines to score points
Try to beat your high score!
Perfect for quick gaming sessions anytime, anywhere. Challenge yourself, improve your skills, and enjoy the timeless fun of block puzzles on your wrist!
Download Color Block for Watch now and enjoy the ultimate block puzzle experience on your Apple Watch!
en.subtitle: Classic Block Puzzle Game
